name: Omitama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Omitama city emblem in green and blue: a disc of green above and blue below with white swirling waves.
history: Municipal flag of Omitama, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 March 2006.

features.role: Omitama city emblem — a disc of green above and blue below with white swirling waves
